description: Quality-gate thresholds for promoting a candidate RAG configuration against an approved baseline. Hard gates must all pass; warning metrics are reported but do not block. Regression tolerances are intentionally generous to absorb small-dataset variance on the 50-case benchmark; tighten them as the dataset grows.

recall@5.comment: candidate recall may not fall more than 0.03 below baseline

abstention.precision.comment: must not start abstaining on answerable questions

abstention.recall.comment: known weak spot; warning only until calibrated
